question.text: A non-discretionary/advisory PM may invest/advise up to ______ of AUM in UNLISTED securities.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Non-discretionary/advisory PMs may allocate up to 25% in unlisted, in addition to discretionary universe. **The Trap:** Higher limits apply only to large-value Accredited Investors. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same rule in X-B. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Clearly separate unlisted sleeves in client statements for transparency.
